title: realtime-broadcast-authorization.e2e-spec.ts initial 4/197 failures on fresh disposable container
root_cause: Local disposable-container bootstrap ran only `db:migrate:application`, which by documented, tested design (migration-classification.ts) excludes RealtimeBroadcastAuthorization20260801000001 (category EXTERNAL_MANAGED, since it alters realtime.messages owned by Supabase's Realtime extension, not the app's public schema). The follow-up `db:migrate` (unfiltered) step that applies EXTERNAL_MANAGED migrations was not run before the first e2e pass.
evidence: apps/api/src/database/migration-classification.ts:8-16,45-54 (canonical classification source, documents the empirical `must be owner of table messages` constraint)

apps/api/scripts/verify-realtime-external.ts:1-16 (read-only physical verifier, not an applier; exit 0 = APPLIED_AND_VERIFIED or PENDING_EXTERNAL_PRIVILEGE, exit 1 = real DRIFT/INVALID_POLICY/UNSAFE_PUBLIC_ACCESS)
docs/engineering/database.md:19-23 (documents the EXTERNAL_MANAGED split and points to both files)

.github/workflows/ci.yml:277 (unfiltered db:migrate as CI's primary path) and :293-310 (a dedicated segmented-executor test proving db:migrate:application correctly skips the migration, then db:migrate converges it, then verify:realtime-external confirms APPLIED_AND_VERIFIED)
own execution this session: db:migrate:application alone -> 4/197 e2e failures; adding db:migrate (unfiltered) -> 7/7 focused pass, 197/197 full e2e pass

answers_to_10_questions.what_does_db_migrate_application_apply: Only migrations where getMigrationCategory() returns APPLICATION (default category unless explicitly listed EXTERNAL_MANAGED or PRIVILEGED)
answers_to_10_questions.why_excluded: Alters realtime.messages, owned by Supabase Realtime extension schema, not public; app connection role does not own it in real environments; leaving it in the default sequential runner would block all subsequent APPLICATION migrations on an unrelated privilege failure
answers_to_10_questions.official_command: npm run db:migrate (unfiltered) -- confirmed by CI (ci.yml:305-306) and by own execution
answers_to_10_questions.canonical_fresh_db_process: db:migrate:application (asserted to skip Realtime) -> db:migrate unfiltered (converges) -> verify:realtime-external (expects APPLIED_AND_VERIFIED) -- exact sequence in ci.yml:293-310
answers_to_10_questions.test_setup_uses_complete_process: own local setup did not on the first pass (used only db:migrate:application); fixed this session by adding the db:migrate step, now matches CI
answers_to_10_questions.dev_setup_uses_complete_process: NOT_PROVEN as a single copy-paste step for a first-time human dev -- docs/engineering/database.md explains the WHY and points to the right files but does not spell out the exact 3-step CI sequence in one place; classified as a minor documentation-completeness observation, not a functional bug
answers_to_10_questions.exact_cause_of_initial_4_failures: own incomplete local bootstrap command sequence, not a product/migration/bootstrap-script defect
